description:
Copy your files faster and more securely.

TeraCopy is a utility designed to copy files faster and more secure. It can verify copied files to ensure they are identical. It skips bad files during copy, not terminating the entire transfer. Seamless integration with Windows Explorer.
Enhancements
- Added support for receiving files from LocalSend 1.18 clients.
- The free space check is now skipped when moving files on the same drive.

Fixed Bugs
- Fixed a deadlock that could occur while updating progress.
- Fixed rare crashes when generating MD5, SHA1, and SHA256 checksums.
- Minor UI fixes.
